cohort: The study included 216 patients undergoing preinduction of labor with a dinoprostone 10mg controlled-release vaginal device.
finding: Patients not responding to the first application of dinoprostone had significantly higher BMI and gestational weight gain, and a double application was related to poorer neonatal outcomes compared to a single application.
mod_finding: Double application of dinoprostone resulted in spontaneous delivery in 58.4% of cases, compared to a single application.
